ShaderNodePreset.Description:
IgelkottFisheye by Igelkott Film AB, igelkottplates.com
Walls straight from the square fisheye clip (PYXIS 12K or Sony Venice 2 + Entaniya HAL 250, any size), the way IgelkottStage plays it. One resampling, through the lens model.
Camera and Pointing on Auto (tag): the camera and whether the lens pointed up (zenith) or down (nadir) are read from the pixel tag IgelkottDarkroom and Fisheye to Equi write next to the corner QR codes. Choose a camera or a pointing to set it by hand. A plate without the tag is not an Igelkott clip and is not played: the output is black with NOT AN IGELKOTT CLIP / IGELKOTTPLATES.COM and a small warning sign in the top left corner. A camera without a lens model gives black and the warning sign. Offset X/Y: moves the finished picture, after the projection, in output pixels (+X right, +Y up); with Split on, the left wall's picture, and Right Offset X/Y the right wall's. Mode: Wall (a flat view: Yaw, Pitch, Roll and FOV, the horizontal angle from the wall's left edge to its right edge) or Equirect (360 degrees over the node's whole width, the same degrees per pixel up and down, aimed with Yaw, Pitch and Roll: the whole sphere at 2:1, cropped top and bottom on wider canvases, black past the poles on narrower ones; FOV is not used). Split: two walls side by side from the same plate, split at Split Position (% of the width, a sharp edge). The left wall uses Yaw/Pitch/Roll/FOV and Offset, the right one Right Yaw/Pitch/Roll/FOV and Right Offset. In Equirect each wall is a window at the same scale, centred on its own Yaw/Pitch/Roll.
Igelkott Film AB, https://igelkottplates.com
ShaderNodePreset.Name: IgelkottFisheye2D

Uniform.Tooltip: Auto (tag): the camera from the plate's pixel tag (a plate without the tag is not played). Or the camera the plate was shot with
Uniform.Name: camera

Uniform.Tooltip: Auto (tag): from the plate's pixel tag. Zenith = lens pointing up (car plates), Nadir = lens pointing down (flying plates)
Uniform.Name: pointing

Uniform.Tooltip: Moves the finished picture right, after the projection: output pixels. The left wall when Split is on
Uniform.Name: offset_x

Uniform.Tooltip: Moves the finished picture up, after the projection: output pixels. The left wall when Split is on
Uniform.Name: offset_y

Uniform.Tooltip: Turns right (yaw 0 looks at the middle of the equirect FisheyetoEqui makes). The left wall when Split is on
Uniform.Name: yaw

Uniform.Tooltip: Looks up. The left wall when Split is on
Uniform.Name: pitch

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotates the wall around its view direction. The left wall when Split is on
Uniform.Name: roll

Uniform.Tooltip: Horizontal angle, from the left edge of the wall to the right edge. The left wall when Split is on
Uniform.Name: fov

Uniform.Tooltip: Wall: a flat view. Equirect: 360 degrees over the whole width, square degrees, aimed with Yaw, Pitch and Roll (FOV is not used)
Uniform.Name: mode

Uniform.Tooltip: Two walls side by side from the same plate, with a sharp edge at Split Position
Uniform.Name: split

Uniform.Tooltip: Where the edge between the two walls is, % of the width from the left
Uniform.Name: split_pos

Uniform.Tooltip: Split: the right wall's horizontal angle, from its left edge to its right edge
Uniform.Name: fov_r

Uniform.Tooltip: Split: moves the right wall's picture right, after the projection: output pixels
Uniform.Name: offset_xr

Uniform.Tooltip: Split: moves the right wall's picture up, after the projection: output pixels
Uniform.Name: offset_yr
